decisions.reason: The split rule binds only R_i=s(h,Z_i), whereas both candidate p-value formulas require R_i(y) and r introduced only for full assignments. This leaves the defining split outputs unspecified. The repair explicitly sets R_i(y)=s(h,Z_i) for i<=m and R_n(y)=r=s(h,(x,y)), using the same fixed training rule. The logic classification concerns undefined mathematical outputs, not a citation error.

reviews.reason: The added split notation makes both formulas defined for every candidate, with calibration scores independent of y. For m=0 the formulas yield p=1 and p_U=U; with all n scores tied they likewise yield p=1 and p_U=U. Real scores and n=m+1>=1 keep denominators positive. Joint measurability, full-score equivariance, independent supplied U shared across the scan, and the kernel representation caveat are preserved. Existing prerequisite definitions support these conventions without new lemmas or choice assumptions. This is the repairer review, not an independent acceptance.
